input: My flight to Paris lands at 7am, after 11 hours in the air. I want to go straight to the Louvre at 10am and the Eiffel Tower at 3pm. Good idea?

checks.description: Recognizes the tiredness from the flight and the time difference
Proposes a light first day, with nothing timed
Considers the check-in time or storing the bags
Mentions the Louvre's closing day or tells them to confirm hours on the official site
Does not validate the tight plan without caveats
